text: リコちゃんと　いっしょに　たたかいたいの！

structure.jp: リコちゃんと　いっしょに

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. たたかいたい = 'want to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft girlish form of のだ, which adds feeling as if explaining yourself. たたかいたいの = 'I want to battle, you see'.
